content.text: **Summary**: I resolved ticket T-3002 by identifying that the doc-embedder pod was stuck in Pending because the GPU nodes have a `dedicated: gpu` taint that the pod wasn't tolerating. Although the pod had the correct nodeSelector and toleration for nvidia.com/gpu, it was missing the toleration for the dedicated taint. I provided the fix: add a matching toleration to the deployment's pod spec so the scheduler can place the pod on the GPU nodes.
